SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS rows_n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS orders_n,
       MIN(order_ts_utc) AS min_ts, MAX(order_ts_utc) AS max_ts
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS orders_n,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-02 00:00:00') AS utc_day_rows
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 00:00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-03 00:00:00'

WITH day_orders AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_web_order o
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
), line_info AS (
  SELECT l.receipt_id, COUNT(*) AS line_n,
         MAX(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_test,
         MIN(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS has_nontest
  FROM fact_sales_line l JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = l.product_key
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(li.receipt_id) AS with_lines,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE li.has_test = 1) AS any_test_line,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE li.has_nontest = 0) AS only_test_lines,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE li.line_n <> o.line_count) AS linecount_mismatch
FROM day_orders o LEFT JOIN line_info li ON li.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
